items.source:
Get all elements matching the given query.
Respects KeySpace if present and therefore returns all elements that can be assigned to requested type..
items.translation:
获取所有匹配给定查询的元素。
如果存在 KeySpace，则予以尊重，因此返回所有可分配给请求类型的元素。

items.source: Interface that specifies a basic set of key/value operations. Implemented by KeyValueTemplate.
items.translation: 定义基本键/值操作的接口的接口。由KeyValueTemplate实现。

items.source: Get all elements of given type. Respects KeySpace if present and therefore returns all elements that can be assigned to requested type.
items.translation: 获取给定类型的所有元素。如果存在KeySpace，则予以尊重，因此返回所有可分配给请求类型的元素。

items.source: Get all elements ordered by sort. Respects KeySpace if present and therefore returns all elements that can be assigned to requested type.
items.translation: 按排序获取所有元素。如果存在KeySpace，则予以尊重，因此返回所有可分配给请求类型的元素。

items.source: Get element of given type with given id. Respects KeySpace if present and therefore returns all elements that can be assigned to requested type.
items.translation: 获取给定类型和给定 id 的元素。如果存在 KeySpace，则予以尊重，因此返回所有可分配给请求类型的元素。

items.source: Get all elements in given range. Respects KeySpace if present and therefore returns all elements that can be assigned to requested type.
items.translation: 获取给定范围内的所有元素。如果存在KeySpace，则予以尊重，因此返回所有可分配给请求类型的所有元素。

items.source: Get all elements in given range ordered by sort. Respects KeySpace if present and therefore returns all elements that can be assigned to requested type.
items.translation: 获取给定范围内按排序顺序排列的所有元素。如果存在KeySpace，则予以尊重，因此返回所有可分配给请求类型的元素。

items.source: Remove all elements of type. Respects KeySpace if present and therefore removes all elements that can be assigned to requested type.
items.translation: 移除所有指定类型的元素。如果存在KeySpace，则尊重该注解并因此移除所有可分配给请求类型的所有元素。

items.source: Total number of elements with given type available. Respects KeySpace if present and therefore counts all elements that can be assigned to requested type.
items.translation: 给定类型可用的元素总数。如果存在KeySpace，则予以尊重，因此会计算所有可分配给请求类型的元素。

items.source: Total number of elements matching given query. Respects KeySpace if present and therefore counts all elements that can be assigned to requested type.
